title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Theater on 1969-04-26
lineage: cassette master > 1 cassette generation > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience tape that nevertheless captures a fiery 1969 Electric Theater set with a groundbreaking Feedback → What’s Become of the Baby jam and a soaring Mountains of the Moon.
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as an intense, avant‑garde performance – highlights include the wild Feedback/What’s Become of the Baby sequence, a lyrical rendition of Mountains of the Moon, and a tight Cryptical → Other One → Eleven sandwich.  Recording quality is mixed; listeners note hiss, muddiness and occasional inaudible moments, but the unique material makes it worth trading.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise the musical performance; technical issues are noted but do not outweigh the show’s historic and energetic qualities.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several listeners mention hiss, muddiness, and occasional inaudible sections (e.g., ‘moon’ segment), though the feedback/PA loop is captured clearly.

standout_songs: Feedback → What’s Become of the Baby
Cryptical > Other One > Eleven > Other One > It's a Sin
show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, well‑sequenced set with strong transitions and an extended jam sandwich in the encore; unique avant‑garde moments keep momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals described as passionate; no specific guitar remarks.
